what_it_is: All-titanium expandable lumbar interbody spacer for TLIF/PLIF. Inserted contracted, continuously expands up to 7mm. RISE IntraLIF variant: percutaneous via 8.5mm cannula with extraforaminal access.
sizing_specs: Expands up to 7mm. IntraLIF: 8.5mm cannula delivery.
indications: TLIF, PLIF. IntraLIF for percutaneous approach.
